svg.title: ssfr: public-reference ISO12233 reconstruction
svg.desc: Approximate public-reference reconstruction. Not certified ISO-compliant. See data/modern_profiles.json for measured and selected parameters.
svg.metadata: {"coordinate_unit": "mm", "geometry_verified_against_full_2024_standard": false, "parameters": {"background": 0.18, "black": 0.009, "cell_size_mm": [290, 270], "column_gap_mm": 100, "gap_background": 0.08, "inner_radius_fraction": 0.1, "marker_holes_mm": [[16, 6], [266, 6], [16, 256], [266, 256]], "patch_positions_mm": [[260, 50], [260, 30], [230, 0], [210, 0], [60, 0], [40, 0], [10, 30], [10, 50], [10, 200], [10, 220], [40, 250], [60, 250], [210, 250], [230, 250], [260, 220], [260, 200]], "phase_rad": 0, "radius_mm": 125, "white": 0.9}, "provenance": {"documented": {"cell_star_markers_patches": "publicly accessible 2014 reference, Annex E table E.2: 290x270 mm, star diameter 250 mm, marker/patch coordinates", "modulation": "144 cycles; 72-cycle alternative and 18% background, old Annex E and indexed 2024 E.1; primary vendor data independently corroborate cycle counts", "patch_levels": "equally spaced in linear reflectance, 16 steps from bright to dark"}, "measured_or_inferred": {"centre_mask": "radius 1/10 of outer star radius estimated from authors Figure 8", "grid": "3x3 arrangement from authors paper and old Figure E.1; 100 mm horizontal gaps estimated from relative star-centre spacing", "top_right_marker": "white-hole y=6 mm follows visible symmetry in Figure 8; old E.2 lists y=0, so this is a recorded override"}, "selected": {"gap_background": "0.08 synthetic dark gap", "phase": "0 radians selected convention", "reflectance": "0.9 / 0.009 (100:1), synthetic endpoints, within publicly documented high-contrast range; not measured material values"}}, "reconstruction": "public-reference reconstruction; measured layout and explicitly selected parameters", "standard_certification": false, "status": "available_public_reconstruction", "target_standard": "ISO 12233:2024"}
